verdict.rationale: Bolt's own docs describe selecting Supabase during project creation to get a hosted SQL database, auth, and edge functions wired directly into the project without switching tools (bolt-docs-8, bolt-docs-22, bolt-docs-27). However, community evidence shows real friction—one builder hit token limits and errors right after adding a database (bolt-comm-4), and another user notes Bolt/Lovable simply outsource the backend to Supabase, capping how much true 'in-builder' control you get (bolt-comm-11). missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth end-to-end provisioning flow, and detail on schema/migration management beyond initial setup.
